description: SP-08 deny (Claude Code 2.1.301), ADR-006 items 4 and 6, 15 §4.1 keys: one usage unit per assistant message.id. The second message.id is written as two rows (a thinking block, then the text), each carrying the same usage: they are one unit, sealed once by the result line, never counted twice. The denied Write is a tool step that failed (its tool_result is_error); the turn continues and concludes (15 §2.7: a Deny keeps the turn). Fidelity 2, no reasoning tokens reported.
